about_the_game:
YOUR TAIL IS YOUR AMMUNITION

Bulletail combines classic Snake gameplay with intense bullet-hell combat in a truly unique roguelike experience. Every shot costs precious tail length — eat bullets to grow stronger, but shoot too much and you’ll shrink!

Core Mechanics

  • Snake Movement: Classic WASD controls — don’t hit yourself!

  • Unlimited Ammo System: Your snake’s length IS your ammunition.

  • Risk vs Reward: Eat bullets to grow (+1 segment = +10 ammo), but shooting costs ammo (10 shots = −1 segment).

  • Progressive Damage: Each enemy hit removes more segments than the last.

  • Instant Death: Run out of ammo OR hit yourself = immediate game over.

Combat Features

  • 6 Unique Weapons: Pistol, Shotgun, Laser, Homing Missiles, Explosives, Piercing Bullets.

  • 8 Enemy Types: From Basics to Teleporters, Snipers, and Shield Carriers.

  • Epic Boss Battles: 3 legendary bosses every 10 waves with multi-phase fights.

  • 10 Temporary Powerups: Speed Boost, Invincibility, Rapid Fire, Time Slow, Ghost Mode, and more.

  • 8 Permanent Upgrades: Damage, Fire Rate, Durability, Speed — choose 1 after each wave.

Strategic Depth

Balance aggressive combat with conservative ammo management. Early hits are recoverable, but consecutive hits become devastating. Choose upgrades to craft unique builds and dominate later waves!

Bulletail offers endless replayability through its one-of-a-kind ammo system. Can you master the balance between growth and survival to reach the highest waves?

legal_notice:
© 2025 ApeXPloit Studios. All rights reserved.

All gameplay systems, visuals, code, and art are original creations developed specifically for Bulletail.

Bulletail utilizes open-source technologies including:
- Electron framework (MIT License)
- TypeScript (Apache License 2.0)
- Various Node.js dependencies

The game’s sound effects are generated in real-time using the Web Audio API, with no third-party copyrighted music or samples.

While inspired by classic Snake and bullet-hell genres, Bulletail’s mechanics and design are uniquely implemented as original creative works.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 18.04 LTS or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (64-bit) or AMD FX-4300 (or newer)
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Intel HD Graphics 4000 / AMD Radeon R5 (must support Vulkan 1.1)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (64-bit) or AMD Ryzen 3 1200 (or newer)
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU — NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD RX 570 or better (Vulkan 1.2 support)
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any
